items.title: Missing baby rescued, found buried alive a day after authorities say his father took him
items.brief: A South Carolina infant who authorities say was taken by his father was found alive Tuesday, buried in a dog crate in the woods after apparently spending about 24 hours underground, officials said.

items.title: The GOP delivers its answer to midterms rout: It’s intensifying the fight
items.brief: Republicans have chosen a counterintuitive remedy for voters’ stunning midterm election rebuke of President Donald Trump: more Trumpism.

items.title: US Army soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of espionage related to Russia
items.brief: A 41-year-old United States Army soldier was arrested in the United Kingdom on Tuesday on suspicion of espionage related to Russia, according to London’s Metropolitan Police.

items.title: At least 3 people dead after vehicle strikes pedestrians in North Hollywood, officials say
items.brief: At least three people are dead and two others are injured after an SUV crashed into a group of street vendors and pedestrians near a Metro entrance in the North Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, officials said…

items.title: Look of the Week: Nvidia’s CEO appeared in a very stylish archival leather jacket. If only it were real
items.brief: When an image purportedly showing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in his first public appearance since reports of an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy surfaced online, it quickly went viral.

items.title: Tech consultant sentenced to 16 years to life in stabbing death of Cash App founder Bob Lee
items.brief: The tech consultant convicted in the stabbing death of Cash App founder Bob Lee was sentenced in San Francisco on Tuesday to 16 years to life in prison.

items.title: First snow, coldest air in months headed for eastern US in wake of storm
items.brief: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States later this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some.

items.title: Ukraine peace talks restart after 9 months. What makes them different this time?
